svg.title: A toolbox release changes a line I edited myself, and the update merge request shows both: a toolbox update moves the AI agent files to .agents and keeps the team's own work
svg.text: A toolbox release changes a line I edited myself, and the
Scenario: a toolbox update moves the AI agent files to .agents and keeps the team's own work
The team's work sits in the old .agent folder
The release moves the folder, and only the team's edit is left to settle

g.text: Given the team added a rule of its own and a line to a toolbox rule in the old .agent
folder, on the main branch
The project came from toolbox release 1.0.0, which kept the AI agent files in a folder named .agent, without the s. The
developer adds a rule of the team's own, .agent/rules/our-team.md, and one line to a toolbox rule,
.agent/rules/stability.md, then pushes the commit to the main branch.
GitLab's page for that commit, "docs: add our own rules for the AI agents": the new file and the added line, in green.

text.tspan:
printf '# Our team rule

Run the e2e suite before every merge request.
' > .agent/rules/our-team.md && echo
'Our CI images are built in project/ci, never in .config.' >> .agent/rules/stability.md && git add -A && git
commit -qm "docs: add our own rules for the AI agents" && git push -q

g.text: When the developer runs the toolbox update to the release that moves the AI agent files to
.agents
Release 1.0.1 moves the AI agent files to .agents, the folder AI tools read today, and adds a line to two toolbox rules
the team never touched. The developer asks for it with one command, from the main branch.
Copier first runs the release's migration, migrate-agents.sh: a toolbox file the team never changed is removed, so the
release writes it fresh in .agents, and every other file moves there with git. One warning follows, for
.agents/rules/stability.md and no other file. The update then opens merge request !1.
Then GitLab shows the team's rule in .agents/rules on the update branch, and no .agent
folder left
GitLab's page for the update branch, update-framework-devsecops, the Files panel open on .agents and its rules:
our-team.md moved there, next to the toolbox rules.
The table lists .agents and .claude/skills, and no .agent folder is left. .agents holds rules and skills only: the eight
step-by-step guides of release 1.0.0 came back as skills.
And the team's line in that toolbox rule waits between conflict markers in the rule's new
place
The page of .agents/rules/stability.md on the update branch, the conflict highlighted. The release did not change this
rule, it moved it, so Copier cannot tell the team's line from the toolbox's copy.
The team's line waits under "<<<<<<< before updating", for the developer to keep or drop before merging. Nothing was
lost.

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 4 steps · 4 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
● Given: stage ● When: actions ● Then: proofs
